summary: Baileys fork — static keyword co-occurrence in utility file, no traced installer harm
details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library. A a static rule matched on keyword co-occurrence (the tokens 'ping' and 'GET' appearing in lib/Utils/generics.js and elsewhere), which is the normal shape of a WhatsApp protocol utility module (WebSocket keep-alive pings, HTTP GETs for media endpoints). No specific installer secret is shown to be read, no non-first-party exfiltration destination is named, no lifecycle scripts fetch or execute remote code, and no install-time or import-time attacker-benefit mechanism is evident in the shipped code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
